description: Terrain inputs for LunaScout. Files live under DATA/ (not in git). Run scripts/fetch_data.py to download and verify them.

files.content: Surface height, 80S to pole, 20 m squares
files.format: Cloud-optimized GeoTIFF, 30400 x 30400, float32, NaN = no data (none present), overviews 2-64x, 512x512 tiles
files.values: Height in metres above a 1737.4 km reference sphere (radius = 1737400 + value)
files.grid: Top-left corner (-304000, 304000) m, 20 m squares, +y points toward 0 deg E (Earth side), +x toward 90 deg E
files.frame: MOON_ME, Mean Earth/polar axis of JPL DE421. Use SPICE frame MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 when combining with DE440 ephemerides.
files.notes: Every square has a value, but most squares near the pole are interpolated between laser tracks. See the LDEC count map for which squares were measured.
files.citation: Barker, M.K. et al. (2023), Planet. Sci. J. 4, 183, doi:10.3847/PSJ/acf3e1; dataset doi:10.60903/gsfcpgda-lola-spole

files.content: Number of LOLA laser shots in each 20 m square (0 = height was interpolated)
